review_method: Read actual frozen two candidate sources and patch; compare current BellstriderEncounter state transitions and PlatformingModule installation; independently hash candidates and compare original failure/await/loop/recovery text. No engine or main modification.

findings.detail: Capture reads exactly the installed plains_bellstrider_arena module, validates authored versus installed one-way rectangle transforms and body IDs, and observes PlayerMotor slide normals/is_on_floor. Pilot uses installed low-tier nearest support and actual body_contact_rect front only as input timing; it does not replace collision evaluation or manufacture support. True effective maximum_jumps==1 and no hook are checked.

findings.topic: Single leg ownership and return direction
findings.detail: first/all use one group owner and one leg action procedure. Return reuses prior support. Actual Encounter direction flips at combo_brake end with roll_index=1; candidate reads live direction, not immutable initial plan.direction. Landed legs keep zero axis through combo states; pending landing may finish during the original combo_warning, with no new warning time. Actual index1 roll without admission fails.
Final source returns for the same already-completed group and for terminal; it does not re-admit its exposed plan from observe/dead. Earlier draft hashes are excluded.

New action procedure returns before board/evade input decisions when original wave_jump is true; original wave block remains later and wins. Existing recovery two-shot code is byte-identical. Natural wave/recoil may make support or chain proof fail; latched failure is retained and does not retry targets or fake a jump.

Active group HP observation extends through groups_completed or real terminal. Both receipt paths share validator with inclusive completion-tick player events, actual warning/support/takeoff/cross/landing, exact observed roll group ledger and real presentation_event stream. Terminal requires cached actual health terminal/zero, actual death and defeated evidence. Invalid object never implies victory. Event stream avoids production history truncation without changing production storage.

25 original failure.append source lines, await/selected loop lines and original recovery-shot block independently compare equal. Original 7200 combat loop/180 wrapper budget, input adapter, initial placement, health/resources and production source are not changed by this patch.

result_interpretation_limits: Not compiled or executed by this reviewer. Only accepts the exact external candidate for one bounded root-run experiment; does not establish full-fight success, fairness, GUI behavior or CI migration.

All scope validates every actually selected roll group, but does not assert that phase2 return_roll occurred at least once. A later review must inspect actual committed plan/ledger for a completed two-leg phase2 group before claiming return-roll coverage; absence is unexercised, not a passed return-roll test.

Exact two requests and two real base-one hits in each roll and terminal group are additional diagnostic premises. An early terminal first hit may fail this premise; never add a postmortem shot or silently weaken it.
Nearest support reachability within each natural warning and higher-speed return-front timing remain runtime hypotheses; no offline estimate proves success.
Original flat-floor late-jump and full-fight failures remain failed evidence. This acceptance does not authorize changing their assertions or replacing a no-damage positive with an expected failure.
